what: digital spiking cores with SRAM synapses

eta.derivation: SRAM macro efficiency (bitcells over the macros' area) of the T1 chips that print their SRAM macro area

points.label: MorphIC
points.expression: s('T1-MO-01', 'scope', '256 kB synapse SRAM, 32 kB neuron SRAM', 256 + 32) * 8192 * sigma(65) / (v('T1-MO-01', 2) * 1e6)

held_out.rule: every fitted value is re-derived with the held-out chip's entries removed (by id prefix); a point that reads one is dropped, a point that meets a named refusal is dropped by name
held_out.record: the toolchain's held-out estimate (area_rule/parity.py; tests T-6, T-27)

s.derivation: the memory share of a T1 core per calibration chip (memory bits x sigma / eta over its core area), geometric mean; MorphIC at core scope (M6); a point whose cell rule B refuses is dropped by name

points.label: MorphIC
points.expression: s('T1-MO-01', 'scope', '256 kB synapse SRAM, 32 kB neuron SRAM', (256 + 32) * 8192) / s('T1-MO-01', 'scope', '4 cores', 4) * sigma(65) / r('types/t1:eta') / ((v('T1-MO-01', 1) * (1 - (v('T1-MO-02', key='router L1') + v('T1-MO-02', key='router L2') + v('T1-MO-02', key='clock generator')) / 100) / s('T1-MO-01', 'scope', '4 cores', 4)) * 1e6)

points.label: ReckOn
points.expression: s('T1-RK-01', 'scope', '(138 kB SRAM total)', 138 * 8192) * sigma(28) / r('types/t1:eta') / (v('T1-RK-01') * 1e6)

held_out.rule: every fitted value is re-derived with the held-out chip's entries removed (by id prefix); a point that reads one is dropped, a point that meets a named refusal is dropped by name
held_out.record: the toolchain's held-out estimate (area_rule/parity.py; tests T-6, T-27)

gamma.derivation: the core-grid share of the T1 dies (cores x core area / die), geometric mean

outside_parts.derivation: the published outside parts of the dies gamma averages (die less its core grid); the type rule's fixed-outside reading holds the largest (MA-3, T-28)

points.label: Loihi
points.expression: v('T1-LO-01') * (1 - s('T1-LO-01', 'quote', '128 neuromorphic cores', 128) * v('T1-LO-05') / v('T1-LO-01'))
